description: This file defines the SiloClusteringValidator class which implements configuration validation logic specific to cluster membership in Orleans. It checks if the clustering provider is configured and validates certain cluster membership options.

classes.name: SiloClusteringValidator
classes.description: A validator class for cluster membership configuration that implements the IConfigurationValidator interface.

methods.name: ValidateConfiguration
methods.description: Performs validation of the cluster membership configuration options, ensuring required services are available and options are within valid ranges.
